title: spec-runner preflight --json
description: Read-only readiness report (#142a). Stable surface: pin `schema_version`. Preflight writes nothing and never guesses — a fact it cannot establish is reported as `unavailable`, never as `ok`.

schema_version.description: Bumped when this payload changes shape

verdict.description: ready = nothing blocks a run; blocked = at least one blocking check

exit_code.description: The process exit code that accompanied this payload: 0 ready, 1 blocked

blockers.description: Ids of the checks that block, for callers that only need the headline

status.description: ok = fine; missing = tool/file absent; empty = a suite with no tests (never proof of health); broken = present but unusable (e.g. collection errors); unavailable = could not be established honestly; skipped = disabled by config

blocking.description: Whether this prevents a run under the current config — a missing git is not blocking when git automation is off
